about: Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego (BGK) is Poland's state-owned national development bank, headquartered in Warsaw, wholly owned by the Polish government. It manages state funds, guarantees and EU programmes, finances infrastructure, housing and local government projects, and supports small companies. It serves government bodies, municipalities and businesses rather than retail customers. Funding shown is about $2.5 billion. Public institution with low consumer visibility.

Bank Mandiri is Indonesia's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Jakarta and majority-owned by the Indonesian government, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BMRI). It offers retail, corporate, SME and digital banking, including the Livin' by Mandiri app, with tens of millions of customers and a presence in Singapore, Hong Kong and elsewhere. A familiar household brand in Indonesia and active in sport and sponsorship locally.

Garanti BBVA is one of Turkey's largest private banks, headquartered in Istanbul and majority-owned by Spain's BBVA. It provides retail, SME, corporate and digital banking, with several hundred branches, tens of millions of customers, and assets of the order of tens of billions of dollars. Listed on Borsa Istanbul (GARAN). It has long been a sponsor of Turkish sport and arts, and is a household brand in Turkey.

Halkbank (Turkiye Halk Bankasi) is a Turkish state-owned bank headquartered in Ankara and Istanbul, listed on Borsa Istanbul (HALKB). It offers retail, commercial and SME banking, with a focus on small tradespeople and artisans, through hundreds of branches. The state holds the majority through the sovereign wealth fund. It has been involved in a US legal case over sanctions evasion. Well-known domestic consumer bank, with a history of sports sponsorship in Turkey.

Intrum is a Stockholm-based credit management company that collects debts and buys non-performing loans for banks, telecom, utility and retail clients across about 20 European countries. It earns fees and returns on purchased portfolios, and has been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. It carried heavy debt and completed a restructuring in 2024 to cut leverage and extend maturities. B2B, with a low and sometimes negative public profile among consumers.

National Bank of Greece is the oldest and one of the largest Greek banks, founded in 1841 and headquartered in Athens, listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (ETE). It provides retail, corporate and investment banking and insurance through hundreds of branches in Greece. The Hellenic Financial Stability Fund has gradually sold its stake. It is a household name in Greece with a long history of sponsorship.

National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) is Kuwait's first and largest bank, founded in 1952 and headquartered in Kuwait City, listed on Boursa Kuwait. It provides retail, corporate, private and investment banking, with operations across the Gulf, the Middle East, Europe, and the US, and a large customer base. NBK is known for strong credit ratings and sponsors cultural and sporting events. It has a high-profile brand across the region.

Piraeus Bank is one of Greece's four systemic banks, headquartered in Athens and listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (TPEIR). It offers retail, corporate, investment and digital banking through hundreds of branches in Greece, serving millions of customers. It acquired Ethniki Insurance's business and bought Aegean Baltic Bank. The Hellenic Financial Stability Fund has sold down its stake. Strong domestic consumer brand.

Alinma Bank is a Saudi Arabian Sharia-compliant bank headquartered in Riyadh, established in 2006 and listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 1150). It offers retail, corporate, SME and treasury banking through branches and digital services, with assets of the order of 200 billion riyals or more. The Public Investment Fund is a major shareholder. Well-known retail bank in Saudi Arabia that has sponsored local sports and events.

Bank of Maharashtra is a state-owned Indian public sector bank headquartered in Pune, founded in 1935 and listed on the National Stock Exchange of India. It provides retail, SME and corporate banking through over 2,500 branches, mainly in Maharashtra and across India, with millions of customers. The Government of India is the majority shareholder. Known as a regional consumer bank, with moderate national awareness.

Banobras (Banco Nacional de Obras y Servicios Publicos) is a Mexican state development bank that finances public infrastructure and services, such as roads, water, urban transport and municipal projects, and provides guarantees and technical help to state and local governments. It is wholly owned by the Mexican federal government and is based in Mexico City. Customers are public bodies and infrastructure developers rather than retail clients, so consumer brand awareness is low.

Bridgit is an Australian privately owned non-bank lender, according to Crunchbase, based in Sydney, providing finance to borrowers outside traditional banks, and has recorded funding of about $1.3 billion, likely mostly debt facilities. Customers are likely property investors and small businesses. Revenue comes from interest and fees. It should not be confused with the Canadian construction software company Bridgit. Low public brand visibility. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Credit Agricole is a French cooperative banking group, headquartered in Montrouge near Paris, one of the largest banks in Europe, with retail banking through regional banks and LCL, asset management through Amundi, insurance and corporate banking. It serves tens of millions of customers worldwide and is listed on Euronext Paris through Credit Agricole SA. A major household brand in France that has sponsored cycling and other sports.

DMI Finance is a New Delhi-based non-banking financial company that provides digital consumer, personal and small business loans, often through partnerships with fintech, e-commerce and auto platforms, plus lending against vehicles. It is backed by Sumitomo Mitsui Trust, Apollo and the Kotak-related investors and has raised about $1.3 billion of equity and debt. Customers are Indian consumers and small firms. Moderate consumer awareness, mostly through partner apps.

It offers Sharia-compliant retail, corporate and real estate banking, with assets of about 100 billion riyals. Qatar Investment Authority and Qatari entities are significant shareholders. Known mainly within Qatar for retail banking.

about: Elevate Credit was a Fort Worth, Texas online lender that provided credit solutions to non-prime US and UK consumers, through brands such as Rise, Elastic and Sunny, with higher-cost instalment loans and lines of credit. It listed on the New York Stock Exchange (ELVT) in 2017 and was acquired by Park Cities Asset Management in 2023. Customers were underserved consumers who could not access prime credit. Some consumer advertising, but low trust brand image.

FirstCash is a Fort Worth, Texas operator of pawn stores, listed on Nasdaq (FCFS), with over 3,000 locations across the US and Latin America, mainly Mexico, Guatemala and Colombia, plus the American First Finance lease-to-own business. Customers are cash-constrained consumers, who pledge goods for loans or buy second-hand items; revenue is about $3 billion. It owns brands such as First Cash Pawn and Empeno Facil. Strong local consumer presence but low national brand awareness.

Grupo Financiero Banorte is a Monterrey-based Mexican financial group, listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange (GFNORTE), and the country's only major bank that is Mexican-owned. It offers retail and corporate banking, brokerage, insurance, pensions and long-term savings, and acquired Bank of Mexico's Banamex partly. It has tens of millions of customers and assets of several hundred billion dollars. Strong consumer brand in Mexico, with extensive sports sponsorship.

Huatai Securities is a Chinese brokerage and investment bank headquartered in Nanjing, listed in Shanghai (601688) and Hong Kong, one of the largest securities firms in China. It provides retail brokerage via the Zhangle Fortune app, wealth management, investment banking, asset management and trading, and owns AssetMark in the US. It has millions of retail investors. Known in Chinese finance, with limited consumer awareness elsewhere.

iCapital is a New York-based fintech, founded in 2013, that offers a platform for wealth managers, banks and asset managers to access and distribute alternative investments such as private equity and hedge funds to high-net-worth clients. It earns platform and servicing fees and has raised about $1.5 billion at a valuation of about $7.5 billion, with backers including BlackRock and UBS. B2B, strong among wealth advisers, but low general public awareness.

Indian Bank is a Chennai-based public sector bank, founded in 1907 and majority-owned by the Government of India, listed on the NSE and BSE. It merged with Allahabad Bank in 2020 and offers retail, MSME and corporate banking through nearly 6,000 branches across India and a few abroad. Funding shown is about $1.5 billion. Strong regional consumer presence, particularly in southern India.

Julius Baer Group is a Swiss private banking group based in Zurich, listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (BAER), that manages about 500 billion Swiss francs of client assets for wealthy individuals worldwide, with offices in Switzerland, Asia, the Middle East and Europe. It earns advisory, custody and asset management fees. Well known as a luxury wealth manager and a sponsor of tennis, sailing and Formula E-style events.

OTP Bank is Hungary's largest independent banking group, headquartered in Budapest and listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange (OTP). It provides retail, SME and corporate banking in Hungary and a number of Central and Eastern European countries, including Bulgaria, Croatia, Serbia, Slovenia, Ukraine and Uzbekistan. It serves more than 17 million customers. It has strong consumer brand recognition across the region and sponsors sport and cultural events.

Plaid is a San Francisco financial technology company, founded in 2013, whose software lets consumers connect bank accounts to apps like Venmo, Robinhood and Coinbase, and supplies data, payments and identity services to developers and banks. It earns fees from companies using its API, and reached a valuation of about $6 billion after raising about $1.3 billion. Visa's 2020 $5.3 billion purchase was abandoned. B2B, but widely seen by consumers in the Plaid Link screen.

Plata is a Mexico City fintech offering a credit card and banking services in Mexico, with recorded funding of about $1.59 billion, including debt, and backing from large international investors. It targets Mexican consumers who want a digital-first credit card with rewards, and earns interchange and interest. Based on public information it is one of Mexico's faster-growing neobanks, though details should be confirmed. Growing consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: PRA Group is a Norfolk, Virginia company, listed on Nasdaq (PRAA), that buys defaulted consumer debt portfolios from banks and lenders and collects on them, operating in the US, Europe, Brazil and Australia. It earns revenue from collections and has about $1.3 billion in funding-related figures shown. Customers are lenders; the public face is as a debt collector, so it has little positive brand visibility.

RBL Bank is a Mumbai-based Indian private sector bank, formerly Ratnakar Bank, listed on the NSE and BSE, offering retail, credit card, SME and corporate banking via about 550 branches and a large credit card business. Emirates NBD took a controlling stake in 2025. Funding shown is about $1.16 billion. Moderate consumer brand awareness in India.

Scotiabank is Canada's third-largest bank by assets, headquartered in Toronto and listed on the Toronto and New York exchanges (BNS), with major businesses in Canada, Mexico, Chile, Peru and Colombia. It provides retail, commercial, wealth and corporate banking to about 25 million customers. It has deep ties to hockey, as sponsor of the NHL and the Scotiabank Arena, and is a high-profile Canadian consumer brand.

Starling Bank is a London-based UK digital bank, founded in 2014 by Anne Boden, offering personal, joint, business and euro accounts through an app, plus lending, and a banking-as-a-service business called Engine used by banks overseas. It has several million customer accounts, was profitable from 2021 and had a valuation of about 4 billion pounds in its 2023 funding. Strong UK challenger bank brand with marketing in sport and business circles.

Talanx is a Hanover-based German insurance group, the parent of HDI and Hannover Re, one of the world's largest reinsurers. It offers industrial, retail and reinsurance cover in over 175 countries, and is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (TLX). Premium income is in the tens of billions of euros. Retail brand HDI is known in Germany and Latin America; Talanx itself is mainly B2B.

The Baldwin Group, formerly BRP Group, is a Tampa, Florida insurance distribution firm, listed on Nasdaq (BWIN), which sells commercial, personal and employee benefit insurance through independent agencies and MGAs, including Westwood and Hylant (after the 2025 acquisitions). Revenue is above a billion dollars. Customers are US businesses and individuals. B2B and agency-driven, with limited national brand awareness.

The Saudi Investment Bank (SAIB) is a Riyadh-based Saudi bank listed on the Saudi Exchange (1030), offering corporate, retail, treasury and Islamic banking, with branches across the kingdom and assets of about 130 billion riyals. Shareholders include Saudi government-linked institutions and private investors. Mostly known in the Saudi banking market, with moderate consumer awareness.

Zurcher Kantonalbank is a Zurich-based Swiss cantonal bank owned by the Canton of Zurich, with a state guarantee, and one of Switzerland's largest banks by assets. It provides retail, corporate, private banking and asset management services, with about 5,000 employees, and is known for its ZKB exchange traded funds. Customers are residents and businesses in the Zurich region. Strong domestic consumer brand in Switzerland.

EXL (ExlService Holdings) is a New York-based data analytics and digital operations business, listed on Nasdaq (EXLS), which provides business process outsourcing, analytics and AI services to insurers, banks, healthcare and utilities, with major operations in India. Revenue is about $2 billion with over 55,000 employees. Customers are large enterprises. B2B, little consumer awareness.

Bank Aljazira is a Jeddah-based Saudi bank listed on the Saudi Exchange (1020), offering Sharia-compliant personal, corporate, treasury and investment banking, with a network of branches across Saudi Arabia. Assets are about 120 billion riyals. Customers are Saudi individuals and businesses. A regional retail bank with moderate consumer awareness in the kingdom.

Credem Banca (Credito Emiliano) is an Italian bank based in Reggio Emilia and listed on Borsa Italiana (CE), known for its focus on private clients and small businesses and its strong profitability. It offers retail, corporate and private banking with a presence mainly across northern and central Italy. Funding shown is about 1 billion. Moderate consumer awareness in Italy.

Cross River Bank is a Fort Lee, New Jersey chartered bank, founded in 2008, that provides infrastructure for fintech companies, offering lending, payments and card issuing for firms such as Affirm and Upstart, plus its own lending and crypto services. It has raised about $958 million, with a $3 billion valuation in 2021. B2B, known among fintechs but with minimal consumer brand awareness.

Mashreq Bank is a Dubai-headquartered bank founded in 1967, one of the UAE's largest private banks, listed on the Dubai Financial Market. It provides retail, corporate and investment banking, with a digital neobank (Mashreq NEO) and operations in Egypt, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and London. It is controlled by the Al Ghurair family. A strong UAE consumer brand that sponsors sport and culture.

Tata Capital is a Mumbai-based Indian non-banking financial company in the Tata Group, offering consumer, commercial and infrastructure loans, wealth management and cards. It is a subsidiary of Tata Sons and was listed on the NSE and BSE in October 2025. Funding shown is about $914 million. Benefits from the strong Tata name in India and advertises to consumers.

Union Bank of India is a Mumbai-based public sector bank, majority-owned by the Government of India and listed on the NSE and BSE, formed in 1919 and enlarged in 2020 by merging Andhra Bank and Corporation Bank. It offers retail, MSME and corporate banking through about 8,500 branches. Funding shown is about $1.1 billion. Widely known Indian retail bank brand.

Westpac is one of Australia's big four banks, headquartered in Sydney and founded in 1817 as the Bank of New South Wales, listed on the ASX (WBC). It provides retail, business and institutional banking and wealth services in Australia and New Zealand, with about 13 million customers. Strong consumer brand and long-time sponsor of sport and community events.

MNT-Halan is an Egyptian fintech group in Cairo formed by combining the Halan motorbike-based mobility business with MNT, led by founder Mounir Nakhla. It offers microfinance and consumer lending, including Tasaheel, to underbanked consumers and small businesses. It became a unicorn in 2022 after a funding round led by Chimera. Strong consumer awareness in Egypt through advertising.

Toronto point-of-sale financing platform that provides consumer lending for home improvement and other big-ticket purchases, with contractors and retailers as its customers. Customers apply for instalment loans at the point of sale. B2B2C with limited public brand awareness outside Canadian home services.

about: Kazakhstan fintech super-app and bank, Kaspi.kz, based in Almaty and offering payments, marketplace shopping and consumer finance to millions of customers. Listed on Nasdaq (KSPI). Founders Mikheil Lomtadze and Vyacheslav Kim built it from a bank into a super-app with about 14 million monthly active users, including Kaspi Pay, Kaspi Red instalments and Kaspi Travel. Very high consumer awareness in Kazakhstan.

US credit card issuer for consumers who are building credit, based in Richmond, Virginia, spun out of Capital One's partner business as a standalone lender. Customers are people with fair or limited credit; revenue is interest and fees. Private and investor-backed. Modest consumer awareness.

about: Brazilian fintech serving solar installers, offering financing for solar projects and a marketplace, headquartered in Sao Paulo. Raised funding from investors including Valor Capital and grew in distributed solar finance. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Mumbai-based non-bank financial company offering personal loans, education loans and wealth management, with funding from investors linked to Vikram Pandit. Consumer lending brand with modest awareness in India.

New York neobank for immigrants, letting newcomers get US credit cards and bank accounts using their foreign credit history. Founded in 2020 with funding from Accel and others. It was founded by Raghunandan G, who previously started the cab-hailing start-up TaxiForSure, and Priyadeep Sinha, with a strong India link. Consumer fintech brand with moderate awareness among immigrants.

Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait (ABK) is a Kuwait City commercial bank providing retail, corporate, private banking and Islamic-style financial services to customers in Kuwait, with branches and subsidiaries in places such as Egypt, Qatar and the UAE, and a Lebanese presence. Founded in 1967 and listed on Boursa Kuwait (ABK). Crunchbase shows about $1.9 billion in funding. Recognised consumer bank in Kuwait; sponsor of sports and events regionally.

about: BADEA is the Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa, an intergovernmental development finance institution headquartered in Khartoum, Sudan, owned by Arab League member states, which finances development projects across sub-Saharan Africa and fosters Arab-African cooperation. Funding from the Crunchbase data is about $1.8 billion. Governmental, B2B institution with minimal consumer brand awareness.

about: Banca Transilvania is Romania's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, providing retail, SME and corporate banking, cards, digital banking (BT Pay), leasing, asset management and insurance, with a network of branches and millions of customers, helped by its 2015 takeover of Volksbank Romania and the 2022 acquisition of OTP Bank Romania. Listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (TLV). Strong consumer brand in Romania and a visible sponsor of sports and cultural events there.

Banco do Brasil is Brazil's largest bank by assets, majority state-owned by the federal government, headquartered in Brasilia, with retail, corporate, agribusiness and investment banking, and tens of millions of customers through thousands of branches. Founded in 1808, it is listed on the B3 exchange (BBAS3). One of the best-known consumer brands in Brazil and a long-time major sponsor of sport, notably volleyball and football.

Bladex (Banco Latinoamericano de Comercio Exterior) is a Panama City, Panama multinational bank founded in 1978 that provides trade finance and corporate loans to banks and companies across Latin America. Shareholders include central banks and state institutions, and it is listed on the NYSE (BLX). Customers are financial institutions and corporates. Crunchbase shows about $2.1 billion in funding. B2B bank, little public consumer awareness.

CAF (Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean, formerly Corporacion Andina de Fomento) is a multilateral development bank headquartered in Caracas, Venezuela, owned by Latin American, Caribbean and some European and Spanish member countries, providing loans, guarantees and technical assistance to governments and companies for infrastructure, climate and social projects. Crunchbase shows about $2 billion in funding. B2B institution, minimal consumer brand awareness.

about: Monzo is a London-based digital bank founded in 2015, known for its coral-pink card and app, providing current accounts, savings, loans, business banking and overdrafts to more than 12 million customers in the UK, with an expansion in the US and EU. It holds a full UK banking licence. Crunchbase shows funding of about $1.8 billion. Private (valuation over 4 billion pounds). Consumer brand with strong UK awareness among younger customers.

Mr. Cooper Group is a Dallas-based mortgage servicer and originator, servicing around a million loans for millions of homeowners, with the Mr. Cooper brand for consumers and originations, and the Xome real estate platform. Formerly Nationstar Mortgage, renamed in 2018. Listed on Nasdaq (COOP). Rocket Companies agreed to buy it in 2025 in a deal worth about $9.4 billion, completed in 2025. Consumer-facing mortgage brand, moderately known in the US.

Opportunity Finance Network is a Washington, DC non-profit network of community development financial institutions (CDFIs) that lends capital to underserved communities, small businesses and affordable housing in the US. It provides financing, training and advocacy to its members. Crunchbase shows about $2.3 billion in funding. Mission-driven non-profit; not a typical sponsorship target and with low consumer brand awareness.

Wholly government-owned, it issues bonds internationally. Customers are corporations and foreign governments. Crunchbase shows about $2.3 billion in funding. B2B policy bank with low consumer brand awareness.

Ziraat Bank (Turkiye Cumhuriyeti Ziraat Bankasi) is Turkey's largest state-owned bank, headquartered in Ankara, with a branch network of over 1,700 and large retail, agricultural, SME and corporate banking, as well as international branches. Owned by the Turkey Wealth Fund, founded in 1863. A very well-known consumer bank in Turkey and a long-standing sponsor of Turkish sports, including football.

Apollo PK AirFinance is a provider of loans secured by aircraft, serving airlines and lessors; the Crunchbase location is in Bavaria, Germany. It was a joint venture of Apollo Global Management and PK AirFinance (Germany and US). Total funding listed is about $1.6 billion. Beyond this, its current ownership and activity are not clear from the data available. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Arab National Bank (ANB) is a Saudi bank headquartered in Riyadh, providing retail, corporate, treasury, private banking and Islamic products through hundreds of branches. Founded in 1979, it is listed on Tadawul (1080), with Riyad Bank and Saudi Arabian shareholders. A recognised consumer bank in Saudi Arabia, with sponsorship in local sport and events.

Bank of Nanjing is a Chinese city commercial bank headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu, providing retail, corporate and treasury banking in Jiangsu and neighbouring provinces. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (601009), with BNP Paribas as a shareholder and Nanjing state entities among others. Crunchbase shows funding of about CN 10 billion yuan. Strong regional brand in eastern China and sponsor of local events.

Berlin Hyp is a Berlin-based commercial real estate bank providing property financing, notably for office, retail, logistics and residential, and a pioneer in green Pfandbriefe. Owned by Landesbank Baden-Wurttemberg (LBBW) since 2022 after Landesbank Berlin and the savings banks sold it, it is a B2B lender. Crunchbase shows funding of about 1.5 billion euros. Little consumer brand awareness.

Gulf International Bank (GIB) is a Bahrain-based wholesale bank, headquartered in Manama, owned by the six Gulf Cooperation Council states with the Saudi Public Investment Fund as the largest shareholder, offering corporate, investment, treasury and asset management services, including GIB Capital in Riyadh. Founded in 1975. Crunchbase shows about $1.4 billion in funding. B2B bank with low consumer awareness.

Northern Trust is a Chicago-based financial institution founded in 1889, providing asset servicing, wealth management, asset management and banking to institutions and wealthy individuals, with over $1 trillion in assets under management and trillions under custody. About 23,000 employees worldwide. Listed on Nasdaq (NTRS). Well known in institutional finance and a long-standing golf sponsor, having backed the PGA Tour's Northern Trust playoff event.

PNB Housing Finance is a New Delhi-based Indian housing finance company that provides home loans, loans against property and construction finance to retail customers. It is promoted by Punjab National Bank, listed on NSE and BSE (PNBHOUSING), and Carlyle holds a stake. Revenue is from loan interest. A recognised mortgage brand in India with branches nationally, though not a major sponsor.

Qatar International Islamic Bank (QIIB) is a Doha-based Sharia-compliant bank offering retail, corporate and investment banking, financing, and wealth management in Qatar and some regional operations. Founded in 1990 and listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange (QIIB). Crunchbase shows about $1.25 billion in funding. A recognised local consumer bank, with sponsorship activity in Qatari sport and events.

about: Raymond James Financial is a St. Petersburg, Florida financial services firm offering wealth management, investment banking, asset management and banking, with over 8,000 financial advisors and about $1.5 trillion in client assets. Revenue exceeds $12 billion. Listed on the NYSE (RJF). It holds the naming rights to Raymond James Stadium, home of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, and is an established US sports sponsor.

ZhongAn Online is a Shanghai-based online insurer, China's first fully online property and casualty insurance company, founded in 2013 by Ant Financial, Tencent and Ping An. It sells e-commerce returns, health, consumer finance and auto insurance via partners such as Alibaba. Listed in Hong Kong (6060). Revenue is around 30 billion yuan. Digital consumer insurance brand with recognition in China.

Zopa is a London-based UK digital bank, founded 2005 as the world's first peer-to-peer lender, which received a banking licence in 2020 and now offers savings, personal loans, credit cards and current accounts, with over a million customers. It is privately held (valued at about 1 billion pounds). Consumer brand with moderate UK awareness.

ABN AMRO Bank is a Dutch bank based in Amsterdam, with retail, private and corporate banking and a strong position in the Netherlands, and around 20,000 employees. The Dutch state held a majority stake after a 2008 bail-out and has been reducing it, with shares on Euronext Amsterdam (ABN). In 2025 it agreed to buy NIBC. Recognisable Dutch consumer brand and long-time sponsor of events including tennis in Rotterdam.

Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait (BBK) is a Manama, Bahrain financial group founded in 1971, offering retail, corporate and Islamic banking, wealth and investment services in Bahrain, Kuwait and abroad, including through its majority stake in CrediMax. Listed on the Bahrain Bourse (BBK). Crunchbase shows about $900 million in funding. Established regional consumer bank, with a history of sponsoring sport and events in Bahrain.

The Federal Bank is an Indian private sector bank founded in 1931 and headquartered in Aluva, Kerala (Crunchbase lists Ernakulam), with over 1,500 branches, retail, SME and corporate banking, and a strong NRI customer base. Listed on NSE and BSE (FEDERALBNK), with Blackstone and Fairfax taking stakes. A well-known southern India consumer bank and an official sponsor of Kerala Blasters football club.

Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank) is a Mumbai-based government-owned financial institution created in 1982 to support India's foreign trade and investment, offering export credit, lines of credit to foreign governments, and project finance. Customers are exporters, importers and overseas buyers. Crunchbase shows about $1.1 billion in funding. State-owned B2B institution, with low consumer awareness.

Crunchbase shows about 880 million euros in funding including debt facilities. A brand with moderate consumer reach in southern Europe.

Listed on Nasdaq (COLB). It announced the acquisition of Pacific Premier Bancorp in 2025. Regional consumer and business bank, with community sponsorships.

Alpha Bank is a major Greek bank headquartered in Athens, offering retail, SME and corporate banking, with branches across Greece and operations in Romania, Cyprus and Albania. Listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (ALPHA), with UniCredit building a stake in 2025. Customers number several million. Leading consumer bank in Greece, with a history of sports and cultural sponsorship.

Israel Discount Bank is one of Israel's largest banks, with retail, commercial and private banking, based in Tel Aviv (Crunchbase shows Rishon LeZion), plus Mercantile Discount Bank and a presence in New York and Los Angeles through IDB New York. Digital-first consumer bank, a well-known name in Poland and a visible sponsor of esports, football and cultural events.

Sohar International is an Omani bank, formed from the 2020 merger of Sohar Bank and HSBC Oman, headquartered in Muscat, offering personal, business and Islamic banking with an extensive branch network. Listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange (BKSB). Crunchbase shows about OMR 505 million in funding. Known consumer bank in Oman and a local sponsor of sports and cultural events.

Standard Bank Group is Africa's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Johannesburg, with retail, business and corporate banking in South Africa and about 20 countries across Africa, and a Chinese ICBC stake historically. Founded in 1862 and listed on the JSE (SBK). Millions of customers. Highly recognised financial brand across Africa, a sponsor of sport, music and the arts.

Kuwait International Bank (KIB) is a Kuwaiti Islamic bank, headquartered in Kuwait City, offering Sharia-compliant retail, corporate and investment banking services. Founded as a conventional bank and converted to Islamic principles, it is listed on Boursa Kuwait (KIB). Crunchbase shows about $1.1 billion in funding. Established regional consumer bank with local sponsorship activity.

Maybank (Malayan Banking Berhad) is Malaysia's largest bank, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, providing retail, commercial, investment and Islamic banking, insurance and asset management in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and other ASEAN markets, serving about 22 million customers. Founded 1960, listed on Bursa Malaysia (MAYBANK). Major consumer brand across ASEAN with extensive sports and cultural sponsorship, including football and golf.

Ajman Bank is an Islamic commercial bank in the emirate of Ajman, UAE, offering retail, business and treasury services under Sharia rules. Founded in 2008 and listed on the Dubai Financial Market (AJMANBANK). Crunchbase shows about $800 million in funding. Regional consumer bank, with sponsorship of local events.

Alkami Technology is a Plano, Texas cloud-based digital banking platform company, founded in 2009, providing online and mobile banking, onboarding and fraud tools to banks and credit unions in the US. Listed on Nasdaq (ALKT) since 2021. Customers are around 300 financial institutions. B2B software, with end-customer brand hidden behind clients.

D360 Bank is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia based digital bank offering mobile-based banking services to individuals and businesses. It is a newer Saudi digital bank licensed by the Saudi central bank, with recorded funding of about SAR 3.1 billion. Income comes from banking products such as accounts, payments and financing. The input gives no detail on customer numbers. As a new consumer-facing digital bank it is building brand awareness in the Saudi market. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Customers are banks, brokers, asset managers and corporates, and revenue comes from trading, clearing, settlement, custody and market data fees. It has around 15,000 employees and is listed in Frankfurt (DB1) and part of the DAX index. It is B2B with moderate brand awareness among investors.

about: Helvetia Baloise Holding AG is a Basel based insurer formed by the 2025 merger of Helvetia and Baloise, creating one of Switzerland's largest insurance groups. It provides non-life, life, pension and reinsurance products to private and business customers in Switzerland, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Austria, Belgium and Luxembourg. It has roughly 20,000 employees and premium volume above 20 billion francs. It is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (HBAN). Both brands are well known domestically and were sponsors of Swiss sport.

Jana Small Finance Bank, based in Bengaluru, grew from Janalakshmi Financial Services, a microfinance lender, and converted to a small finance bank in 2018. It offers loans, savings accounts and deposits to low-income households and small businesses in India, with branches across many states. It is listed on the NSE and BSE (JSFB) since its 2024 IPO and has been backed by investors such as Westbridge and Morgan Stanley Private Equity Asia. It is a regional consumer bank with modest national brand awareness.

KA Fund Advisors is a Tennessee based investment adviser focused on public and private energy investments, per Crunchbase, with recorded funding of about $790 million. about: MYbank is a Chinese private online bank based in Hangzhou, launched in 2015 as part of Ant Group (Alibaba affiliate). It provides small business and rural loans using big-data credit scoring, serving tens of millions of small businesses and individuals through Alipay and Taobao ecosystems. Crunchbase shows registered capital of about CN 6 billion. It is a digital bank with strong exposure to Ant Group's consumer platforms, though itself a B2B-leaning lender.

NexBank is a Dallas, Texas bank providing institutional banking, mortgage servicing, capital markets and investment banking services, with focus on commercial real estate and mortgage-related clients. It is the banking arm of NexPoint-affiliated businesses founded by Jim Dondero and has a high concentration of institutional clients rather than consumer branches. Funding is recorded at roughly $852 million. It has around a few billion dollars in assets. It is a B2B specialist with little consumer brand awareness.

about: Norddeutsche Landesbank (NORD/LB) is a Hanover, Germany state bank owned mainly by the states of Lower Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt and the savings banks associations, restructured in 2019-2020 after a recapitalisation. It provides corporate, real estate, ship and aircraft financing, energy and infrastructure lending, capital markets services and Landesbank functions for savings banks, with total assets in the range of 100 billion euros. It also includes Bremer Kreditbank and Deutsche Hypothekenbank. It is a B2B bank with regional brand recognition.

Pinnacle Financial Partners is a Nashville, Tennessee bank holding company with Pinnacle Bank, providing commercial and consumer banking, wealth management and mortgage services across Tennessee and the Southeast US. Its total assets are around 50 billion dollars after merging with Synovus in 2026. Pinnacle is listed on Nasdaq (PNFP) and is known for its employee-focused culture and as a regular entrant in best-places-to-work lists. It is a regional bank brand with a strong presence in the US South.

It is the largest operation of Santander in Latin America and listed on B3 (SANB11) and the NYSE. Santander is a major consumer brand, also known for its sports and Formula 1 sponsorship globally, including Ferrari.

Shift is an Australian business lender based in North Sydney, providing finance to small and medium sized businesses, including equipment finance, working capital and invoice products. about: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) is a state-owned development bank, headquartered in Lucknow with offices across India, established in 1990 to finance and support micro, small and medium enterprises. It provides refinance to banks, direct loans, venture funds and credit guarantees. It is owned by Indian financial institutions led by the central government and regulated by the RBI. It is a government development lender with a B2B profile and low consumer brand awareness.

Bancomext (Banco Nacional de Comercio Exterior) is a Mexican state-owned development bank headquartered in Mexico City, created to promote exports, foreign trade and investment through financing and guarantees. It lends to Mexican exporters, importers and large companies and funds strategic projects, as part of the federal development banking system. It is a government institution, B2B in focus, with recognition among Mexican businesses but limited consumer brand awareness.

Capitolis is a New York based financial technology company that provides a capital optimization platform for banks and institutional investors in the foreign exchange and rates markets, cutting balance sheet costs for trades. Founded in 2017 by Gil Mandelzis, it has raised large rounds from investors such as Citi and Goldman Sachs-type banks and valued at about 1.1 billion dollars in 2021. Funding is shown around $558 million. It is a B2B fintech firm with low public brand awareness.

Dave is a Los Angeles based consumer fintech with a banking app offering small cash advances (up to a few hundred dollars), spending accounts, and budgeting tools, aimed at underserved Americans. It earns money from optional tips, subscription fees and interchange from the Dave Banking debit card. Founded in 2016, it has millions of members, and became public on Nasdaq (DAVE) in 2022 through a SPAC. It is a widely advertised consumer brand in the US, with celebrity marketing.

Earnin is a Mountain View, California fintech whose app lets workers access part of their earned wages before payday, with optional tips instead of mandatory fees, plus tools like balance alerts. It was founded in 2013 by Ram Palaniappan and has served millions of users in the US, partly funded by investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Matrix Partners. The record shows about $565 million in funding. It is a consumer brand with significant app-store and social advertising reach in the US.

Fora Financial is a New York based small business lender providing merchant cash advances, term loans and lines of credit to small and medium businesses, mainly through brokers and online channels. Founded in 2008, it has funded billions of dollars to tens of thousands of businesses. Crunchbase shows about $613 million of funding, largely debt facilities. It is a B2B fintech with moderate brand awareness among small-business owners.

about: Fulton Bank is the principal subsidiary of Fulton Financial Corporation, a Lancaster, Pennsylvania bank holding company with around 25 billion dollars in assets. It provides consumer and commercial banking, mortgage and wealth management services through branches in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Maryland, Delaware and Virginia. Fulton Financial is listed on Nasdaq (FULT). Founded in 1882, it is a regional bank with strong local recognition in the US Mid-Atlantic and some local sports sponsorships.

Jeeves is a Miami based fintech offering corporate cards, expense management and cross-border payments to growth-stage businesses, especially in Latin America, Europe and Canada. Founded in 2020 by Dave Dietrich and Sergio Carvalho and others, it was valued at around 2 billion dollars after a 2021 round and has raised about $653 million. Its customers are startups and SMEs. It is a B2B fintech with a low consumer profile.

Kansai Mirai Bank is a regional Japanese bank based in Osaka, created in 2022 from the merger of Kansai Urban Banking Corporation and Kinki Osaka Bank, and part of Resona Holdings. It provides retail and small-business banking services through branches in Osaka and Kansai, with roughly 6 trillion yen in assets. It is a regional lender, and a fully owned Resona subsidiary. It has moderate local brand awareness in Kansai, not nationwide.

KOHO is a Toronto-origin Canadian fintech (Vancouver is listed here) offering a prepaid Visa card and spending account, savings, credit building and a credit card, through a mobile app. It earns revenue from interchange and subscription fees, and has more than a million customers. Founded in 2014, it is backed by investors such as Portage Ventures, Eight Roads and Drive Capital, with funding of around $641 million. It is a well advertised consumer fintech brand in Canada.

Kotak Mahindra Bank is a Mumbai based Indian private sector bank founded by Uday Kotak, offering retail and corporate banking, credit cards, mutual funds, insurance, investment banking and broking through the Kotak group. It serves tens of millions of customers through over 2,000 branches and digital platforms and is one of India's largest banks by market value. It is listed on the NSE and BSE (KOTAKBANK). It is a major consumer brand in India, well known through its advertising.

Mercury is a San Francisco fintech offering business banking, cards, bill pay and treasury products for startups and small businesses, working with partner banks rather than a charter of its own. Founded in 2017, it has more than 200,000 customers and is valued around 3.5 billion dollars after a 2025 funding round, with about $657 million raised. Customers are startups, ecommerce firms and small companies. It is a B2B fintech with strong startup community awareness.

Raiffeisenlandesbank Niederoesterreich-Wien (Raiffeisen-Holding NOe-Wien) is a major Austrian regional bank group, based in Vienna, serving the Raiffeisen banking network of local co-operative banks in Lower Austria and Vienna. It offers corporate and retail banking, and has stakes in industrial and food companies including Raiffeisen Bank International. about: Du Xiaoman Financial is a Beijing based Chinese fintech that was spun out of Baidu's financial services group in 2018 and was later partly owned by investors including TPG, Carlyle and CPE. Warba Bank is a Kuwaiti Islamic bank that began operations in 2010, offering retail, corporate and investment banking under Sharia principles, including financing, deposit accounts and card services. Consumer-facing bank with regional awareness in Kuwait, little outside the Gulf.

It sells subscriptions and software to businesses, hospitals and professionals worldwide with roughly 6 billion euros of revenue and about 21,000 employees. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn and listed on Euronext Amsterdam (WKL). B2B brand with low consumer awareness.

Landbay is a UK specialist buy-to-let mortgage lender founded in 2014 and based in London. It lends to landlords through brokers using technology to speed up applications and underwriting, funded through its own balance sheet and capital partners. Customers are private landlords and property investors. Backed by private shareholders. Niche financial brand known among mortgage brokers, with little general consumer awareness.
